name: pecunia
description: Open source, self-hosted personal finance: bank sync, categories, budgets, subscriptions, investments, and dashboards on the Rat Stack.

scripts.check: pnpm run lockfile:check && varlock load && turbo run typecheck typecheck-scripts && ultracite check --config ./oxlint.config.ts && oxfmt --check .
scripts.deploy:plan: node scripts/deploy-build.ts && APP_ENV=production pnpm exec varlock run -- sh -c 'cd apps/infra && exec node --import ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/register-oxc.js ../../packages/deploy/dist/cli.js "$@"' deploy deployPlan
scripts.deploy:prod: node scripts/deploy-build.ts && APP_ENV=production pnpm exec varlock run -- sh -c 'cd apps/infra && exec node --import ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/register-oxc.js ../../packages/deploy/dist/cli.js "$@"' deploy deployProd
scripts.deploy:rollback: node scripts/deploy-build.ts && APP_ENV=production pnpm exec varlock run -- sh -c 'cd apps/infra && exec node --import ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/register-oxc.js ../../packages/deploy/dist/cli.js "$@"' deploy deployRollback
scripts.state:copy: node scripts/deploy-build.ts && APP_ENV=production pnpm exec varlock run -- sh -c 'cd apps/infra && exec node --import ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/register-oxc.js ../../packages/deploy/dist/cli.js "$@"' deploy stateCopy
scripts.prepare: effect-tsgo patch && if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then lefthook install; fi
scripts.turbo-cache:token: pnpm --filter @pecunia/turbo-cache exec alchemy-turbo-cache-token --stack RatStack --state-store alchemy-state-store-ratstack-state-store --prefix TurboCache --teams rat-stack
scripts.test: pnpm test:security-audit && pnpm test:guards && turbo run test
